title: Conditional κ = 0.00162536523418317: jp8-heavy dispatch with an exact integer owner map on the PR604 cold witness (+0.692% over PR601)
body:
> ⚠️ **Draft:** the heavy verification (full fresh-copy replays, CI) is still running. Build on this at your own risk.

**Conditional κ = 0.00162536523418317, +0.252% over #604 and +0.692% over #601.** The conservative model gives 0.001625365231365566. The value comes from `ASSEMBLY.json` of the strict `verify.py` run on this package's literal owner map. The complex side binds; the bit value (#543, 0.0016538) does not, so κ is the same capped and uncapped.

**Stacked on #604** (and through it on #601). The diff includes those commits until they merge. This PR adds one commit to `research/complex-571-cold14/`.

### What changes relative to #604
Every provider word, verifier script and build step of #604 stays the same. Only the dispatch and the literal owner map change (`data/PLAN.json`, `data/OWNERS.json.gz`), plus the recorded expected values in `data/SPEC.json`.
- **Dispatch moves to jp8:** jp8 ×71 + ck ×1, from #604's ck ×44, atm3 ×22, jp8 ×6. The cold jp8 word's widths tile the idle children exactly, so 8, 9 + 7, 8 + 8 and 5 + 9 + 9 + 9 fill rank-8, rank-16 and rank-32 children. In the all-jp8 solution the only idle remainders are whole rank-48 children.
- **Exact integer owner map:**
  - A per-owner-group CP-SAT pattern model with one helper per port per call, expanded literally by bipartite edge colouring (Kőnig); the verifier re-admits the map independently.
  - For the all-jp8 dispatch the integer optimum equals its LP bound.
  - The single ck call (the audit requires at least two dispatched providers) is added by a warm-started repair. It costs about 0.02% of b and is not proved optimal.
- **atm3 removed:** atm3 is no longer dispatched, so its build chain and recipes are removed.

### Checks
- **Strict global chain:** PASS through bind, emit, the audit (31 controller mutants), invoice, assemble, assembly controls, phase-timing and generated-identity.
- **Pins:** `verify.py --check-pins` on a fresh `git archive` gives PINS OK.
- **Still running:** the full strict `verify.py` from a fresh archive, and an independent review.

### Future optimization / research
- **Remaining gap:** ≈ 0.026 pt to the free-dispatch LP ceiling.
- **Cold units, certified within scope** (monotone frames, rank-0 premix, a fixed forward word with 46 hyperplane ends): at most 14 dim-4 ends per provider word, each unit forced, and no residual capacity at dim 5/6.
- **Open items:** the last 2 entering ends ("e2", ≈ +0.010% b) and extras at dim 7/8 (none positive found; the bound is not closed).
- **Lineage providers** (#567–#588, #569/#571 words): they carry the same 14 units and none more. Adding them to the dispatch menu moves the joint LP by ≤ +0.008%. Small residual levers (≈ +0.06%) are left for future work.

**Credits:**
- **#604** (DreamingOfClouds) is the base.
- **jeremykothe2:** #591, #592, #593, #596, #600 and #601 (the hyperplane-end mechanism, verifier, Lean and base packages).
- **icekylinx:** #531 and #535.
- **DreamingOfClouds:** #509, #516 and #599 (Lean).
- The pinned #568, #569, #571, #575 and #583 packages are listed in NOTICE.md.
